name: Kirill Sakharov
biography:
My name Kirill Sakharov, and I'm a Fullstack Web Developer.
I am 23 years old, I was born in January 2001 in Belarus, Gomel.
Graduated from college in 2020. My experience in web development is more than 3.5 years. 
My main technology stack is PHP (Laravel), TypeScript (Vue.js or React.js).

data.name: VOZIM.RU
data.description:
Working on the ERP system, support and develop new features 
Developing Mobile REST API for client application, 
Optimization this ERP system 
Migrate from PHP 7.3 to PHP 8.0 and refactoring legacy code 
Develop Tariffs Calculator on PHP and Go 
Develop our UI-Kit on React.js with TS and SCSS 
Create Distance Route API (Go) by OSM and OSRM 

Stack - PHP (7.3, 8.0), Yii 1/2, Laravel (subsystem), Alpine.js, React.js, SCSS, Docker, Go (microservices, gorm, gin-gonic).

data.name: ITPROFIT
data.description:
Develop, refactor and support e-shops, corporate portals on various PHP frameworks and CMS in backend. 
Main project - online store selling furniture, written in Laravel 8 on the backend (SlepengOwl Admin panel, MySQL, docker) and Nuxt 2.6 (Vue.js 2) on frontend (with TypeScript).

data.name: MAGEDIA
data.description:
Develop, refactor and support e-shop on Magento 2 and Magento 1, develop Magento modules.
Main project - service for selling and ordering custom paintings, which is written in Magento 2, Alpine.js and tailwindsss. 
Worked mainly on the backend, but sometimes did small tasks on the frontend.

data.name: LLC MEDIALINE GROUP
data.description:
Develop and support e-shops on Bitrix CMS. 
There was no main project, since I was in the capacity of a “technical support specialist,” so I was simultaneously working on 5 projects at once. 
All these projects are standard online stores on Bitrix CMS.

Worked on optimizing SOAP and SCL queries, fixing bugs and developing new features. 
The usual stack of such projects is PHP (from 5.5 to 7.4), Bitrix, jQuery, sometimes there was Vue.js and the development of a microframework for REST API, based on Bitrix.

data.name: FREELANCE
data.description:
Development of landing pages, corporate portals, simple blogging platforms on PHP (pure or Laravel) on the backend, on the frontend - jQuery, pure JS, CSS (or SCSS).
Also, development of telegrams and VK bots (PHP Telegram Bot, Telegram Here SDK, VK API SDK).
I also had some experience with the telegram MTProto protocol (MadelineProto library).
